item.title: DeepSeek's top-ranked V4 Flash stumbles on real agent tasks as its prices surge
item.description: DeepSeek's V4 Flash has topped model leaderboards and been hailed by developers as a "total monster" since its rollout. But in real-world testing, it completed just 53.8% of a batch of complex agent tasks. Composio ran the model through eight different agent harnesses, including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, on 30 deliberately difficult, multi-step tasks spanning live tools like Gmail, GitHub, Slack, and Google Sheets. Of 240 total runs, 129 passed — and only six of the 30 workflows were completed successfully by every harness tested.The gap illustrates why orchestration, not raw model cap...
